name: Knives
author: Addicting Games
description: Knives is a free mobile-clicker game. With but the click of your mouse or the tap of your finger you can become a legendary knife throwing champion. Take aim at this high-stakes game of patience, precision, and clicking as you launch one knife after the other at the spinning target in the center of the screen. Each level the skill required to accurately hit each target will grow considerably.  There will be obstacles like other daggers and prizes like apples. You need to use your precision skills s an expert knife thrower in order to accurately split every apple and avoid every knife. The life of a professional dagger thrower is not an easy one. You must overcome all of your personal issues, matters of time, an focus yourself entirely on the art of throwing daggers. You seek not riches or fame or even glory. The simple satisfaction of your blade finding its intended target is enough to keep you going. take aim and throw yourself into a good time.
